description: Land Acquisition - Nabadagahawatta, Galewela D/S Division, Matale District
categorisation: This gazette content is exclusively about land acquisition matters under the Land Acquisition Act. It provides detailed notices for acquiring specific land parcels (including lot numbers, descriptions, claimants, and extents) for public purposes related to the Kurunegala-Habarana Railway Project. The content focuses entirely on land/property matters without any government personnel changes, structural changes, or other specialized categories, making it clearly a Land Gazette.
